description: This PHP source file defines the ResponseInterface, a part of the PSR-7 HTTP Message interface specifications, representing an immutable outgoing server response with methods to get and set status code, reason phrase, headers, and message body.

classes.name: ResponseInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for managing an HTTP response message, including status code, reason phrase, and immutability guarantees.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code for the response.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.
